executionPolicy.antiLoopRule: Reject work unless it verifies a missing exit criterion, removes a named completion blocker, or safely advances beyond a deferred true human gate.
executionPolicy.waveSuccessRule: A wave is productive only if it verifies an exit criterion, clears a gate, integrates an exact-SHA candidate, emits a receipt, closes a macrocycle, or advances the execution cursor past a true human gate.
executionPolicy.blockedProjectRule: A true human gate blocks only its exact sensitive action and strictly dependent work; it is persisted to pendingHumanGates and never stops the project scheduler or other enabled projects.
executionPolicy.fanOutRule: Dispatch closure work independently for every enabled project and continue safe work even when one or more human gates are pending.

active.title: Analisi fotografica e checkpoint visivi
active.outcome: Photo analysis is evidence-scored, safe and integrated into progression.

exitCriteria.description: Authenticated photo checkpoints persist source image identity, capture time, analysis version and attributable evidence without silently replacing prior checkpoints.
Photo analysis validates image and model outputs, scores evidence quality and fails closed on malformed, low-confidence or unsafe interpretations.
Longitudinal progression consumes durable visual checkpoint evidence only through bounded explainable signals and remains safe when photo evidence is absent, stale or rejected.
Product CI, independent review, realistic Robot photo-checkpoint-to-progression journey, exact-SHA verification, integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

active.title: Lotti, scadenze, richiami e tracciabilità
active.outcome: Lot-level inventory and safety controls work end to end.

exitCriteria.description: Canonical lot records bind product, location, lot code, expiry and quantity provenance to authoritative durable inventory movements with complete audit attribution.
Receiving, sale and transfer journeys preserve lot identity and FEFO/expiry constraints transactionally and fail closed on invalid, expired or inconsistent lot state.
Expiry risk and recall workflows identify all affected durable stock and movements deterministically without hidden deletion or untraceable mutation.
Duplicate, retried and concurrent lot operations remain idempotent and preserve traceability across restart and reconciliation.
Product CI, independent review, PFarma delta Robot plus required cumulative simulation, exact-SHA integration and post-merge cumulative replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

active.title: Ricerca, filtri, duplicati e qualità archivio
active.outcome: The archive can be searched and cleaned without data loss.

exitCriteria.description: Authenticated archive search resolves durable media metadata, albums, tags and supported date/text fields deterministically within the correct family scope.
Combinable filters and pagination remain stable across restart, equal timestamps and concurrent archive changes without silently skipping or duplicating results.
Duplicate detection uses durable evidence and supports explicit review or reconciliation without destructive automatic deletion or cross-family leakage.
Archive-quality anomalies, missing metadata and object inconsistencies are surfaced with recoverable actions while preserving canonical media and organization state.
Product CI, independent review, realistic Robot search-filter-deduplicate journey, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

transitionRule: Certified completion activates the next macrocycle immediately. A true human gate keeps its macrocycle OPEN as DEFERRED_HUMAN_GATE in pendingHumanGates but also advances the execution cursor so autonomous independent work never stops.
reconciliationRule: Before every wave, replace stale PR, SHA, integration, completion and human-gate fields using live GitHub evidence and commit ancestry; revisit pending human gates on every trigger.
